requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: Requirement contains no linguistic ambiguity but exhibits concern-mixing (functional action + quality criterion). Decomposed into two separate artefacts per Pohl §25.2: a functional requirement for raising the alert and a quality requirement for the alert's visibility.

source_fragments: When a rejection order is received for a cancellation request, System-A must raise a web alert.

fields.condition: a rejection order is received for a cancellation request

structured_requirements.final_statement: When a rejection order is received for a cancellation request, System-A must raise a web alert.
structuring_notes: Extracted the core functional action (raising the alert) from the mixed requirement.

fields.condition: when a rejection order is received for a cancellation request
fields.measurable_criterion: the alert must be visible on the web

structured_requirements.final_statement: The web alert raised by System-A must be visible on the web.
structuring_notes: Extracted the quality attribute (visibility) and its implicit criterion (must be visible) as a separate artefact.
